jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Greptile is an AI code reviewer that catches bugs and anti-patterns in pull requests with complete context of the codebase. Hundreds of top software companies, from YC startups to big tech, and teams in finance, healthcare, and defense, use Greptile to merge PRs faster and catch more bugs.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. A new repo starts using Greptile every 2 minutes. We also uniquely offer self-hosted, air-gapped deployments for enterprises across defense, financial services, and healthcare.

We’re hiring our first field marketer to build the events engine behind Greptile’s next stage of growth. You’ll create high-touch experiences for engineering leaders, build community with developers, and develop programs that can scale beyond what our team can run directly. The work starts with dinners, meetups, workshops, and conferences and builds toward a flagship Greptile user conference.

Responsibilities

  • Make Greptile’s events distinct and memorable, rethinking everything from the format and venue to the overall experience

  • Build and own the field marketing calendar across engineering leadership dinners, technical meetups, workshops, and conferences

  • Run events end to end, from concept and audience strategy through outreach, production, follow-up, and measurement

  • Partner with sales to engage priority accounts and turn event conversations into pipeline and revenue

  • Build community programs that establish a strong Greptile presence in key cities

  • Develop an ambassador program that enables customers, partners, and community members to host events with Greptile

  • Work with engineers and customers to bring the product into demos and technical conversations

  • Own the budget, measure results, and scale the programs that work

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of field or event marketing experience

  • Experience marketing technical B2B software to developers and engineering leaders

  • A track record of building events that generate measurable pipeline

  • Strong project management skills and exceptional attention to detail

  • Creative instincts and a high bar for experiences people remember

  • Comfortable partnering closely with sales, engineers, customers, and external vendors

  • High ownership and the ability to build programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment

You’ll like working here if

  • You want to define how Greptile shows up in the real world

  • You see events as a revenue engine, not just a brand exercise

  • You enjoy moving between creative ideas and detailed execution

  • You want the freedom to experiment, measure what works, and build a repeatable playbook

  • You like working in person with a small, ambitious team

jobs.title: RevOps
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Revenue Operations (RevOps)

Greptile is an AI code validation platform that catches bugs and anti-patterns in pull requests with complete context of the codebase. Hundreds of top software companies use Greptile to merge PRs faster and catch more bugs.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. Our cloud and self-hosted products are used by everyone from YC startups and big tech companies to teams in finance, healthcare, and defense.

Trajectory

  • 22,000+ customers

  • 5B lines of code reviewed every month

  • Scaled from $0 to 8 figures in ARR

  • Raised $30M from Benchmark, Y Combinator, Paul Graham, and Initialized

Team

  • We’ve assembled a small, talent-dense team who have scaled critical functions at companies like Stripe, Google, Figma, and LinkedIn.

The role

We’re hiring our first RevOps person, reporting directly to the CRO. The role is roughly 70% operations and 30% revenue strategy. You’ll build the systems, data, and processes behind the revenue organization while working with the CRO and Finance on planning, market and ICP analysis, and investment decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the CRM and GTM systems stack end to end, including architecture, data integrity, routing, integrations, and vendors

  • Own the revenue forecast process, including its cadence, methodology, and the number that goes to the CEO and board

  • Design and administer quota, territory, and compensation plans with the CRO and Finance

  • Own the mechanics and measurement of the full funnel, from first touch through closed-won, with the Growth team

  • Support the field through deal desk, reporting, approvals, and removing manual work that keeps reps from selling

  • Build annual and quarterly revenue plans using bottoms-up capacity models tied to the top-down number

  • Assess markets, define and defend Greptile’s ICP, and size where we should go next

  • Build GTM investment scenarios with Finance

Qualifications

  • 4–8 years of experience

  • A background combining top-tier strategy consulting with operating experience at a high-growth technology company

  • Able to write SQL, build models, and find answers without waiting for someone else to pull the data

  • Deep working knowledge of modern CRM and GTM tooling; you’ve architected a stack, not just used one

  • A track record of building something from zero, such as a first forecasting process, compensation plan, or territory model

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, low ego about the work, and excited by a role that spans strategy and execution

  • Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate

Nice to have

  • Experience selling or supporting sales into engineering and developer-tools buyers

  • Experience with both product-led and enterprise motions in the same business

  • Experience as the first RevOps hire at a company

  • Early-stage AI company experience

You’ll like working here if

  • You want to build the systems behind a fast-growing revenue organization

  • You want to work directly with the CRO while staying close to the work

  • You enjoy turning incomplete data into clear recommendations

  • You like removing the processes and manual work that keep reps from selling

  • The chaos of high growth is exciting to you

  • You prefer working in person with an ambitious team

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infrastructure Engineer

Greptile is an AI code reviewer that catches bugs and anti-patterns in pull requests with complete context of the codebase. Hundreds of top software companies, from YC startups to big tech, and teams in finance, healthcare, and defense, use Greptile to merge PRs faster and catch more bugs.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. A new repo starts using Greptile every 2 minutes. We also uniquely offer self-hosted, air-gapped deployments for enterprises across defense, financial services, and healthcare.

Problems we’re excited about

  • Coding standards can be idiosyncratic and are often poorly documented; can we build agents that learn them through osmosis like a new hire might?

  • Can we identify for each customer what types of PR feedback they do and don’t care about, perhaps using some sample efficient RL, in order to increase signal-to-noise ratio?

  • Some bugs are best caught by running the code, potentially against discerning AI-generated E2E tests. Can we autonomously deploy feature branches and use agents to parallel try to break the application to detect bugs?

Trajectory

  1. 22,000+ customers

  2. 5B lines of code reviewed every month

  • Scaled from $0 to eight figures in ARR

  • Raised $30M from Benchmark, Y Combinator, Paul Graham, and Initialized

Team

  • We have assembled a small, talent dense team who have scaled critical functions at companies like Stripe, Google, Figma, etc.

Responsibilities (in order of how much time you’ll likely spend on each)

  • Design and implement robust infrastructure to help Greptile keep up with growing usage

  • Work with our largest enterprise customers to help deploy Greptile into their environments

  • Operationalize the on-premise deployment process so we can serve smaller customers without needing much hands-on work.

Qualifications

  • B.S. Computer Science or equivalent degree, undergraduate or higher

  • 1+ years of software, infrastructure or cloud engineering

  • Strong background in computer networking

  • Experience with container runtimes, linux VMs, hypervisors, docker, kubernetes (k8), terraform, and cloud providers like AWS

  • Experience building sandboxed or isolated execution environments

  • Ability to work closely with customers (patience, friendliness)

You will like this role if

  • You want to work on a product that thousands of developers rely on

  • The chaos of high growth and things breaking is exciting to you

  • You like being in an office every day around other smart people who are excited about what they’re building

  • You like tinkering with Docker Containers, Virtual Machines, Compute Clusters.

  • You enjoy playing with Linux systems and reading blogs like this one: https://www.brendangregg.com/linuxperf.html

  • You specifically prefer working in-person over working remote

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Growth Engineer

We want to build agents that autonomously validate code changes. Today that looks like AI that reviews pull requests in GitHub, catching bugs and enforcing standards.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers.

Problems we’re excited about

  • Coding standards can be idiosyncratic and are often poorly documented; can we build agents that learn them through osmosis like a new hire might?

  • Can we identify for each customer what types of PR feedback they do and don’t care about, perhaps using some sample efficient RL, in order to increase signal-to-noise ratio?

  • Some bugs are best caught by running the code, potentially against discerning AI-generated E2E tests. Can we autonomously deploy feature branches and use agents to parallel try to break the application to detect bugs?

Trajectory

  • 22,000+ customers

  • 5B lines of code reviewed every month

  • Scaled from $0 to eight figures in ARR

  • Raised $30M from Benchmark, Y Combinator, Paul Graham, and Initialized

Team

  • We have assembled a small, talent dense team who have scaled critical functions at companies like Stripe, Google, Figma, etc.

Responsibilities

  • Own and ship growth-critical engineering projects end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to building, launching, and iterating based on results

  • Design, build, and run experiments across the full user journey, spanning the marketing website, onboarding, activation, and product interactions

  • Partner closely with product and growth teams to scope ideas and ship high-quality, production-ready implementations

  • Build and own the core analytics and attribution framework, including event instrumentation, dashboards, and reporting used to guide decisions

  • Define and track clear success metrics (e.g. activation, conversion, retention), and use data to decide what to double down on or stop

  • Work across the stack (frontend, backend, and data) to ship pragmatic solutions that meaningfully move key metrics

  • Balance fast, iterative experimentation with higher-conviction projects, owning technical execution in both cases

Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering foundation (frontend, backend, or full-stack)

  • Experience building and shipping user-facing product or web features

  • Comfort working with data, metrics, and experimentation to inform decisions

  • Solid product intuition and curiosity about how users discover, adopt, and stick with products

  • Ability to move quickly, take ownership, and learn through iteration without sacrificing code quality

  • Familiarity with modern web stacks and analytics tooling

  • Interest in how products grow across channels (e.g. paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle email), and eagerness to learn how engineering decisions shape outcomes

  • Bonus: experience with developer tools, product-led growth, or B2B SaaS

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Controller

Greptile is an AI code reviewer that catches bugs and anti-patterns in pull requests with complete context of the codebase. Hundreds of top software companies, from YC startups to big tech, and teams in finance, healthcare, and defense, use Greptile to merge PRs faster and catch more bugs.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. A new repo starts using Greptile every 2 minutes. We also uniquely offer self-hosted, air-gapped deployments for enterprises across defense, financial services, and healthcare.

This is Greptile’s first accounting hire. You will report to the Head of Finance and own accounting end to end, from closing the books and writing policies to implementing an AI-native ERP. You will take us from outsourced bookkeeping to an audit-ready accounting function, then build the team as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own the monthly and quarterly close, including reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, flux analysis, and financial statements

  • Own revenue recognition across self-serve, enterprise, and usage-based contracts, including Greptile’s ASC 606 policy and supporting technical memos

  • Set Greptile’s technical accounting positions across equity, leases, capitalized software, R&D capitalization, and complex deal structures

  • Build the accounting for compute and inference spend, including prepaid commitments, consumption accruals, and gross margin reporting

  • Lead the implementation of an AI-native ERP and its integrations across billing, banking, cards, payroll, and cap table management

  • Own tax and compliance, including corporate tax, sales tax, R&D credits, 1099s, and state filings

  • Run accounting operations across AP, AR, collections, payroll accounting, expenses, and treasury

  • Get Greptile audit-ready and lead our first external audit

  • Build the accounting team as the company grows

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Controller, Assistant Controller, Director, or Senior Accounting Manager scope at a high-growth technology company

  • CPA with a foundation in Big Four audit, ideally within a technology practice

  • Deep ASC 606 experience in a subscription and consumption-based business

  • Experience owning the close and leading or supporting an external audit

  • Experience building an accounting function, or a major part of one, from the ground up

  • Comfortable writing and defending technical accounting memos for complex transactions

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience

  • You use AI seriously in your own work and have strong opinions about where it can improve accounting

Nice to have

  • Experience at a company with both self-serve and enterprise sales motions

  • Experience as an accounting lead through a Series B to E fundraise or IPO diligence

  • SQL proficiency or enough comfort with data to validate numbers at the source

You’ll like working here if

  • You want to build an accounting function from zero instead of inheriting one

  • You want to be the technical authority on the answer while remaining close to the work

  • The speed and responsibility of a high-growth AI company are exciting to you

  • You want a path to CAO and are willing to earn it by building the function yourself

This role is based in San Francisco and requires at least three days per week in the office.
